'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a quest-exclusive NPC that first appears with '''[[Tian]]''' in {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}}. 
__NOTOC__
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Tian:''' The Autopuppets are malfunctioning? How... how is that possible? Could it be false intel?
:'''Baiyou:''' Liangyu said it herself. It has to be true...

==Dialogue==
:'''Tian:''' The Autopuppets are malfunctioning? How... how is that possible? Could it be false intel?

:'''Baiyou:''' Liangyu said it herself. It has to be true...

:'''Tian:''' There must be thousands of Autopuppets across Xuanfang. If they all go rogue, it'll be a catastrophic threat to everyone living here!

:'''Tian:''' Oh, no... I have to get out of here... To Mengzhou... Wait, no. Jinzhou should be closer...

:'''Baiyou:''' Use your head! What happens if a rogue Autopuppet catches you the second you leave the village? What about the Tacet Discords? You're not a Resonator, alright?!

:'''Baiyou:''' Just listen to Liangyu and the others for now...
{{Dialogue End}}
